name: Elixir of Eternal Life
description: The ultimate alchemical masterpiece, said to grant immortality to those worthy enough to create it. This legendary elixir combines the essence of life itself with divine blessings and forbidden knowledge.

special_materials.description: Tears shed by a phoenix at the moment of rebirth
Sap from the ancient World Tree that connects all realms
Blood of the gods, collected during celestial wars
Crystals containing captured souls of ancient heroes
Sand from the hourglass of time itself

unique_properties.description: Grants immunity to death once per day
All divine spells have 100% success rate
Doubles the effectiveness of all auras and blessings
